notes.subject: bɔnya
notes.rationale: בושׁ literally 'to pale'; bɔnya (be disgraced) captures the public-shame sense, not the color image.

notes.subject: יבשו ... יבשו
notes.rationale: The verb 'be ashamed' opens and closes the verse, an envelope structure framing the enemies' retreat.

notes.subject: רגע
notes.rationale: 'In a moment' vs 'in a twinkling'; a very short unit of time, sometimes read as 'at once' or even 'there is nothing (רגע as rest)'.

translation: N ka toniw bɛɛ ka bɔnya, ka tarata bonya la; u na segin, ka bɔnya dɔɔnin dɔrɔn de kɔnɔ.
